description: Starts and orchestrates any video - ads, launch and demo films, motion, title, end and CTA cards, UI walkthroughs, explainers, re-making a reference ad. It picks the format, holds the house laws, writes the one film brief, orders the work (audio first, an independent review before the user sees anything) and routes each job to an executor: video-sound, video-build, video-moves, video-3d, video-generated, video-check. It executes nothing itself. Use first for any video request, before the upstream hyperframes, motion-graphics, general-video, product-launch-video or media-use skills. Triggers: "make a video", "make an ad", "launch video", "demo video", "end card", "title card", "CTA card", "motion card", "logo sting", "explainer", "walkthrough video", "voice it and build it", "make it like this ad".
